Title: Add a new product with all valid required fields
Description: Verify that an admin can successfully add a new product with all required fields filled correctly.
Preconditions: Admin user is logged in and on the product management panel.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Admin Panel > Products > Add New Product. 2. Enter valid product name (e.g., "Wireless Headphones"). 3. Enter valid description. 4. Enter price (e.g., 49.99). 5. Select a category. 6. Upload a product image. 7. Set stock quantity (e.g., 100). 8. Click "Save Product".
Expected Results: Product is created successfully. A confirmation message is displayed. Product appears in the product listing with correct details.

Title: Attempt to add a product with missing required fields
Description: Verify that the system prevents adding a product when required fields are empty.
Preconditions: Admin user is logged in and on the Add Product page.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Admin Panel > Products > Add New Product. 2. Leave the product name field empty. 3. Leave the price field empty. 4. Click "Save Product".
Expected Results: Product is NOT created. Validation error messages are displayed for each required field.

Title: Add a product with price set to 0
Description: Verify system behavior when admin attempts to add a product with a price of zero.
Preconditions: Admin user is logged in and on the Add Product page.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Admin Panel > Products > Add New Product. 2. Enter valid product name. 3. Enter price as "0". 4. Fill all other required fields. 5. Click "Save Product".
Expected Results: System either rejects the product with a validation error or saves it as a free product depending on business rules.

Title: Add a product with a negative price value
Description: Verify that the system rejects a product with a negative price.
Preconditions: Admin user is logged in and on the Add Product page.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Admin Panel > Products > Add New Product. 2. Enter valid product name. 3. Enter price as "-10.00". 4. Fill all other required fields. 5. Click "Save Product".
Expected Results: Product is NOT created. Validation error is displayed: "Price must be a positive value".

Title: Add a product with maximum character limit for product name
Description: Verify that the system handles maximum character length for product name field.
Preconditions: Admin user is logged in and on the Add Product page.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Admin Panel > Products > Add New Product. 2. Enter a product name with 255 characters (maximum allowed). 3. Fill all other required fields with valid data. 4. Click "Save Product".
Expected Results: Product is created successfully with the full name stored and displayed correctly.

Title: Add a product to the shopping cart
Description: Verify that a user can add a product to the shopping cart from the product details page.
Preconditions: User is on a product details page. Product is in stock.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to a product details page. 2. Verify the "Add to Cart" button is visible and enabled. 3. Click "Add to Cart". 4. Navigate to the shopping cart page.
Expected Results: Product is added to the cart. Cart icon updates to show item count. Product appears in cart with correct name, price, and quantity of 1.

Title: Update product quantity in the shopping cart
Description: Verify that a user can increase or decrease the quantity of a product in the cart.
Preconditions: User has at least one product in the shopping cart.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to the shopping cart. 2. Locate the product in the cart. 3. Change quantity from 1 to 3. 4. Click "Update" or confirm the quantity change.
Expected Results: Quantity updates to 3. Subtotal recalculates correctly (unit price × 3). Cart total updates accordingly.

Title: Remove a product from the shopping cart
Description: Verify that a user can remove a product from the shopping cart.
Preconditions: User has at least one product in the shopping cart.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to the shopping cart. 2. Locate the product to remove. 3. Click "Remove" or the delete icon next to the product.
Expected Results: Product is removed from the cart. Cart total recalculates. If cart is empty, a message "Your cart is empty" is displayed.

Title: Attempt to add quantity exceeding available stock
Description: Verify that the system prevents users from adding more items than available in stock.
Preconditions: User is on a product page. Product has limited stock (e.g.
Test Steps: 5 units).
Expected Results: 1. Navigate to product details page (stock = 5). 2. Set quantity to 10. 3. Click "Add to Cart".
column9: System displays an error message: "Only 5 items available in stock" or limits the quantity to maximum available stock.

Title: Set product quantity to zero in cart
Description: Verify system behavior when user sets product quantity to zero in the cart.
Preconditions: User has a product in the cart with quantity 1.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to shopping cart. 2. Change product quantity to 0. 3. Click "Update".
Expected Results: Product is removed from the cart or system displays validation error "Quantity must be at least 1".

Title: Attempt to add an out-of-stock product to cart
Description: Verify that out-of-stock products cannot be added to the shopping cart.
Preconditions: User is viewing a product that is out of stock.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to an out-of-stock product page. 2. Verify the "Add to Cart" button state.
Expected Results: Add to Cart button is either disabled or hidden. An "Out of Stock" label is displayed. User cannot add the product to the cart.

Title: Search for a product by its exact name
Description: Verify that the search functionality returns correct results when searching by exact product name.
Preconditions: Products exist in the system. User is on any page with the search bar visible.
Test Steps: 1. Click on the search bar. 2. Type "Wireless Headphones". 3. Press Enter or click the search icon.
Expected Results: Search results page displays the matching product(s). "Wireless Headphones" appears in the results with correct image, name, and price.

Title: Search for a product using a partial keyword
Description: Verify that the search returns relevant results when a partial keyword is entered.
Preconditions: Products exist in the system (e.g., "Wireless Headphones", "Wireless Mouse").
Test Steps: 1. Click on the search bar. 2. Type "Wireless". 3. Press Enter or click the search icon.
Expected Results: Search results display all products containing "Wireless" in their name or description. Results are relevant and properly paginated.

Title: Search for a product that does not exist
Description: Verify system behavior when search returns no results.
Preconditions: User is on any page with the search bar visible.
Test Steps: 1. Click on the search bar. 2. Type "xyznonexistentproduct123". 3. Press Enter or click the search icon.
Expected Results: Search results page displays a "No products found" message.

Title: Search using special characters
Description: Verify that the system handles special characters in search without errors.
Preconditions: User is on any page with the search bar visible.
Test Steps: 1. Click on the search bar. 2. Type "<script>alert('xss')</script>". 3. Press Enter or click the search icon.
Expected Results: System sanitizes input. No script execution occurs. Either "No results found" is displayed or the special characters are safely escaped.

Title: Filter products by category
Description: Verify that users can browse and filter products by category.
Preconditions: Multiple products exist across different categories.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to the product listing page. 2. Select "Electronics" category from the filter/sidebar. 3. Observe the results.
Expected Results: Only products belonging to the "Electronics" category are displayed. Product count updates to reflect filtered results.

Title: Submit search with empty search field
Description: Verify system behavior when user submits a search with no query.
Preconditions: User is on any page with the search bar visible.
Test Steps: 1. Click on the search bar. 2. Leave it empty. 3. Press Enter or click the search icon.
Expected Results: System either displays all products, shows a validation message, or remains on the current page without error.

Title: Complete checkout as a guest user
Description: Verify that a guest user can complete a purchase without creating an account.
Preconditions: Guest user has items in the shopping cart.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to shopping cart. 2. Click "Proceed to Checkout". 3. Select "Continue as Guest". 4. Enter shipping information. 5. Enter contact email. 6. Select shipping method. 7. Enter payment details. 8. Review order summary. 9. Click "Place Order".
Expected Results: Order is placed successfully. Order confirmation page is displayed with order number. Confirmation email is sent to the guest email address.

Title: Complete checkout as a registered user
Description: Verify that a registered user can complete a purchase with saved details.
Preconditions: User is registered, logged in, and has items in the cart with a saved shipping address.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to shopping cart. 2. Click "Proceed to Checkout". 3. Verify saved shipping address is pre-filled. 4. Select shipping method. 5. Enter payment details. 6. Review order summary. 7. Click "Place Order".
Expected Results: Order is placed successfully. Order confirmation page displays order number. Order appears in user's order history. Confirmation email is sent.

Title: Attempt checkout with an empty cart
Description: Verify that the system prevents checkout when the cart is empty.
Preconditions: User is logged in. Shopping cart is empty.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to shopping cart (empty). 2. Attempt to click "Proceed to Checkout".
Expected Results: Proceed to Checkout button is disabled or hidden. Message "Your cart is empty" is displayed.

Title: Attempt checkout with invalid shipping address
Description: Verify that the system validates shipping address during checkout.
Preconditions: User has items in cart and is on the checkout page.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to checkout. 2. Leave shipping address fields empty or enter invalid data. 3. Click "Continue to Payment".
Expected Results: System displays validation errors for invalid/missing fields. User cannot proceed to payment step.

Title: Register a new account during checkout process
Description: Verify that a guest user can create an account during checkout.
Preconditions: Guest user has items in cart and is on the checkout page.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to checkout. 2. Select "Create an Account" option. 3. Enter email, password, and confirm password. 4. Fill shipping information. 5. Complete payment. 6. Click "Place Order".
Expected Results: Order is placed successfully. New user account is created. User is logged in automatically. Order is saved in the new account's order history.

Title: Apply a valid coupon code during checkout
Description: Verify that a valid coupon code applies the correct discount during checkout.
Preconditions: User has items in cart. A valid coupon code "SAVE10" exists (10% discount).
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to checkout or cart page. 2. Enter coupon code "SAVE10" in the coupon field. 3. Click "Apply".
Expected Results: Coupon is applied successfully. 10% discount is calculated and reflected in the order total. Success message displayed.

Title: Apply an invalid or expired coupon code
Description: Verify that the system rejects invalid or expired coupon codes.
Preconditions: User has items in cart and is on the checkout page.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to checkout or cart page. 2. Enter coupon code "EXPIRED2025" in the coupon field. 3. Click "Apply".
Expected Results: Coupon is rejected. Error message "Invalid or expired coupon code" is displayed. Order total remains unchanged.

Title: Complete payment with a valid credit card
Description: Verify that the payment gateway processes a valid credit card payment successfully.
Preconditions: User is on the payment step of checkout. Cart has items.
Test Steps: 1. Select "Credit Card" as payment method. 2. Enter valid card number (e.g., 4111 1111 1111 1111). 3. Enter valid expiry date. 4. Enter valid CVV. 5. Enter cardholder name. 6. Click "Pay Now".
Expected Results: Payment is processed successfully. Order confirmation page is displayed. Transaction ID is generated.

Title: Attempt payment with a declined credit card
Description: Verify system behavior when the payment gateway declines a credit card.
Preconditions: User is on the payment step of checkout.
Test Steps: 1. Select "Credit Card" as payment method. 2. Enter a test card number that triggers decline. 3. Enter valid expiry and CVV. 4. Click "Pay Now".
Expected Results: Payment is declined. Error message displayed. Order is NOT placed. User remains on payment page.

Title: Attempt payment with an expired credit card
Description: Verify that the system rejects payment with an expired credit card.
Preconditions: User is on the payment step of checkout.
Test Steps: 1. Select "Credit Card" as payment method. 2. Enter valid card number. 3. Enter expiry date in the past (e.g., 01/2020). 4. Enter valid CVV. 5. Click "Pay Now".
Expected Results: Validation error: "Card has expired. Please use a valid card." Payment is not processed.

Title: Complete payment using PayPal
Description: Verify that users can complete payment via PayPal gateway.
Preconditions: User is on the payment step of checkout. PayPal integration is configured.
Test Steps: 1. Select "PayPal" as payment method. 2. Click "Pay with PayPal". 3. Log in to PayPal sandbox account. 4. Confirm payment. 5. User is redirected back.
Expected Results: Payment is processed successfully via PayPal. Order confirmation page is displayed.

Title: Complete payment using a debit card
Description: Verify that users can complete payment using a debit card.
Preconditions: User is on the payment step of checkout.
Test Steps: 1. Select "Debit Card" as payment method. 2. Enter valid debit card number. 3. Enter valid expiry date. 4. Enter valid CVV. 5. Click "Pay Now".
Expected Results: Payment is processed successfully. Order confirmation page is displayed.

Title: Attempt payment with insufficient funds
Description: Verify system behavior when payment fails due to insufficient funds.
Preconditions: User is on the payment step of checkout.
Test Steps: 1. Select "Credit Card" as payment method. 2. Enter a test card that triggers insufficient funds. 3. Enter valid expiry and CVV. 4. Click "Pay Now".
Expected Results: Payment fails. Error message "Insufficient funds" is displayed. Order is not placed.

Title: Verify payment data is transmitted securely
Description: Verify that all payment information is encrypted during transmission (HTTPS/TLS).
Preconditions: User is on the payment page. Browser developer tools are accessible.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to the payment page. 2. Open browser developer tools > Network tab. 3. Enter payment details. 4. Submit payment. 5. Inspect the network request.
Expected Results: All requests use HTTPS (TLS 1.2+). No payment data visible in plain text in request headers or URL parameters.

Title: Verify order confirmation page content
Description: Verify that the order confirmation page displays all required order details after a successful purchase.
Preconditions: User has completed a successful checkout.
Test Steps: 1. Complete a purchase (checkout with valid payment). 2. Observe the order confirmation page.
Expected Results: Order confirmation page displays: Order number, items with quantities and prices, shipping address, payment method (masked), order total, estimated delivery date.

Title: Verify order confirmation email for registered user
Description: Verify that a confirmation email is sent to the registered user after a successful order.
Preconditions: Registered user has completed a successful purchase.
Test Steps: 1. Complete a purchase as a registered user. 2. Check the email inbox. 3. Open the order confirmation email.
Expected Results: Email is received within 5 minutes. Contains order number, items, total, shipping address, estimated delivery, link to track order.

Title: Verify order confirmation email for guest checkout
Description: Verify that a confirmation email is sent to the guest email address provided during checkout.
Preconditions: Guest user has completed checkout with a valid email.
Test Steps: 1. Complete a guest checkout providing email. 2. Check the inbox. 3. Open the order confirmation email.
Expected Results: Email is received at the guest email address within 5 minutes with order details.

Title: Verify email notification on order status change
Description: Verify that users receive email notifications when order status changes.
Preconditions: A completed order exists. Admin updates the order status.
Test Steps: 1. Admin navigates to order management. 2. Admin updates order status to "Shipped". 3. Admin enters tracking number. 4. Admin saves. 5. Check customer's email inbox.
Expected Results: Customer receives email: "Your order has been shipped" with tracking number and carrier link.

Title: Verify order tracking page displays correct status
Description: Verify that users can track their order and see current status.
Preconditions: User has a placed order with a valid order number.
Test Steps: 1. Log in to user account. 2. Navigate to "My Orders". 3. Click on a specific order. 4. View order tracking details.
Expected Results: Order tracking page shows current status, status history timeline, tracking number, and estimated delivery date.

Title: Register a new user with valid information
Description: Verify that a new user can register successfully with valid email and password.
Preconditions: User is on the registration page.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to registration page. 2. Enter a valid email. 3. Enter a valid password. 4. Confirm password. 5. Enter first name and last name. 6. Click "Register".
Expected Results: Account is created successfully. User is redirected to homepage or dashboard. Welcome email is sent.

Title: Attempt registration with an already registered email
Description: Verify that the system prevents registration with a duplicate email address.
Preconditions: Email "existing@example.com" is already registered.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to registration page. 2. Enter "existing@example.com" as email. 3. Fill all other fields with valid data. 4. Click "Register".
Expected Results: Registration fails. Error message "An account with this email already exists" is displayed.

Title: Reset password via email verification
Description: Verify that a user can reset their password using the email verification process.
Preconditions: User has an existing account with a verified email.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to login page. 2. Click "Forgot Password". 3. Enter registered email. 4. Click "Send Reset Link". 5. Check email for reset link. 6. Click reset link. 7. Enter new password and confirm. 8. Click "Reset Password".
Expected Results: Reset link email is received. Link redirects to reset page. New password is saved. User can log in with new password.

Title: Login with valid email and password
Description: Verify that a registered user can log in with correct credentials.
Preconditions: User has a registered account.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page. 2. Enter valid email. 3. Enter valid password. 4. Click "Login".
Expected Results: User is logged in successfully. Redirected to homepage or dashboard. User name displayed in header.

Title: Attempt login with incorrect password
Description: Verify that the system rejects login with an incorrect password.
Preconditions: User has a registered account.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to login page. 2. Enter valid email. 3. Enter incorrect password. 4. Click "Login".
Expected Results: Login fails. Error message "Invalid email or password" is displayed. User remains on login page.

Title: Verify user logout
Description: Verify that a logged-in user can successfully log out.
Preconditions: User is logged in.
Test Steps: 1. Click on the user profile/account icon. 2. Click "Logout".
Expected Results: User is logged out. Session is terminated. User is redirected to homepage or login page.

Title: Verify responsive layout on mobile devices
Description: Verify that the website displays correctly and is fully functional on mobile viewport (375px width).
Preconditions: Application is accessible. Browser is set to mobile viewport (375 × 667 px).
Test Steps: 1. Open application on mobile viewport (375px). 2. Navigate to homepage. 3. Verify navigation menu collapses to hamburger. 4. Browse products. 5. Add product to cart. 6. Navigate to cart and checkout.
Expected Results: All elements properly stacked for mobile. No horizontal scrolling. Text readable without zooming. Buttons easily tappable. Images scale appropriately.

Title: Verify responsive layout on tablet devices
Description: Verify that the website displays correctly on a tablet viewport (768px width).
Preconditions: Application is accessible. Browser is set to tablet viewport (768 × 1024 px).
Test Steps: 1. Open application on tablet viewport (768px). 2. Navigate through homepage, product listings, product detail, cart, and checkout. 3. Verify layout adapts appropriately.
Expected Results: Product grid adjusts to 2-3 columns. All functionality accessible. Forms properly sized. No layout breakage.

Title: Verify layout on desktop viewport
Description: Verify that the website displays correctly on a standard desktop viewport (1920px width).
Preconditions: Application is accessible. Browser is set to desktop viewport (1920 × 1080 px).
Test Steps: 1. Open application on desktop viewport (1920px). 2. Navigate through all major pages. 3. Verify content is properly centered/contained.
Expected Results: Layout uses full width appropriately. Product grid shows 4+ columns. Navigation is horizontal. All elements properly aligned.

Title: Verify product images load correctly
Description: Verify that product images load properly and are optimized for display.
Preconditions: Products with images exist in the system.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to product listing page. 2. Observe product thumbnail images loading. 3. Click on a product to view detail page. 4. Observe main product image and gallery images.
Expected Results: Images load without broken image icons. Images have appropriate alt text. Images properly sized for containers.

Title: Verify form validation provides clear visual feedback
Description: Verify that form validation errors are clearly communicated to users with appropriate visual cues.
Preconditions: User is on a form page (registration or checkout).
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to registration form. 2. Submit with all fields empty. 3. Observe error messages and field highlighting.
Expected Results: Invalid fields highlighted (red border). Error messages near relevant fields. Descriptive error messages. Focus moves to first error.

Title: Verify page load time is within acceptable limits
Description: Verify that key pages load within acceptable performance thresholds.
Preconditions: Application is deployed and accessible.
Test Steps: 1. Open browser developer tools > Performance tab. 2. Navigate to homepage and record load time. 3. Navigate to product listing. 4. Navigate to product detail. 5. Navigate to checkout.
Expected Results: Homepage loads within 3 seconds. Product listing within 3 seconds. Product detail within 2 seconds. Checkout within 2 seconds.

Title: Add a product to the wishlist
Description: Verify that a registered user can add a product to their wishlist.
Preconditions: User is registered and logged in.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to product detail page. 2. Click "Add to Wishlist" button/icon. 3. Navigate to "My Wishlist" page.
Expected Results: Product is added to wishlist. Wishlist icon updates. Product appears in "My Wishlist" page.

Title: Submit a product review and rating
Description: Verify that a logged-in user can submit a review and rating for a purchased product.
Preconditions: User is logged in and has purchased the product.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to purchased product's detail page. 2. Scroll to reviews section. 3. Select 4 out of 5 stars. 4. Enter review text. 5. Click "Submit Review".
Expected Results: Review is submitted successfully. Confirmation message displayed. Review appears on product page. Average rating updates.

Title: Verify automatic tax and shipping calculation
Description: Verify that tax and shipping costs are calculated automatically based on shipping address.
Preconditions: User has items in cart and is at checkout shipping step.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to checkout. 2. Enter shipping address (e.g., California, USA). 3. Select shipping method. 4. Observe order summary.
Expected Results: Tax calculated based on destination. Shipping cost displayed. Order total = Subtotal + Tax + Shipping.

Title: Verify availability of multiple shipping methods
Description: Verify that users can select from multiple shipping methods during checkout.
Preconditions: User has items in cart and is at shipping step.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to checkout shipping step. 2. Enter valid shipping address. 3. Observe available shipping options.
Expected Results: Multiple shipping options displayed (Standard, Express, Overnight). Each shows delivery time and cost. Selecting updates total.

Title: Verify order history displays all past orders
Description: Verify that a registered user can view their complete order history.
Preconditions: Registered user has placed multiple orders.
Test Steps: 1. Log in to user account. 2. Navigate to "My Orders" or "Order History". 3. View the list of past orders.
Expected Results: All past orders displayed in reverse chronological order. Each shows order number, date, total, status.

Title: Admin adds and manages product categories
Description: Verify that an admin can create and organize product categories.
Preconditions: Admin user is logged in to the admin panel.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Admin Panel > Categories. 2. Click "Add New Category". 3. Enter category name. 4. Add description. 5. Click "Save". 6. Assign products to category.
Expected Results: Category created successfully. Appears in category list and storefront. Products assignable.

Title: Verify low inventory notification for admin
Description: Verify that the system sends notifications when product inventory falls below threshold.
Preconditions: Product inventory threshold is set to 5 units.
Test Steps: 1. A product's stock level drops to 4 (below threshold). 2. Check admin notifications/email.
Expected Results: Admin receives notification alerting low inventory. Notification includes product name and current stock level.

Title: Verify search input is protected against SQL injection
Description: Verify that the search functionality sanitizes input to prevent SQL injection attacks.
Preconditions: Application is accessible.
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to search bar. 2. Enter "'; DROP TABLE products; --". 3. Submit search.
Expected Results: Application handles input safely. No database error. "No results found" or safe response returned. Database intact.

Title: Verify session expires after inactivity
Description: Verify that user sessions expire after a configured period of inactivity.
Preconditions: User is logged in. Session timeout configured (e.g.
Test Steps: 30 minutes).
Expected Results: 1. Log in. 2. Wait for session timeout period without activity. 3. Attempt to access a protected page.
column9: User session expired. Redirected to login page. Message "Session expired. Please log in again" displayed.
